correctness.rationale: The basis map e_x↦X^x transports the nonassociative quandle product to α(u)β(v) in the associative group ring, α(X)=X^a, β(X)=X^b. For δ, h=δ(1) obeys h=αh+βh; multiplication M_h is indeed a star derivation and δ−M_h kills 1, commutes with α,β, and is an ordinary ring derivation by surjectivity of both automorphisms. In K[X]/(X^p−1) the truncated logarithm T=log X is an invertible coordinate change modulo (X−1)^p and α(T)=aT, β(T)=bT. Thus multiplication eigenmonomials are precisely d in D, and associative derivation vector fields f(T)∂ commute iff f has exponents 1+jL (L divides p−1). The [M_h,M_g], [f∂,M_h], and [f∂,g∂] commutators yield the full displayed bracket table; no assumption K=F_p is needed. Independent modular linear elimination of original quandle Leibniz equations for p=5,7 reproduced dimensions p=5:(2,2), p=7:(2,3,4,3) across admissible a, including the p=7 stated 2,3,4.
